# ai-ethics-lab

> A machine-readable ethical architecture for AI systems: twenty-nine operational primitives
> adapted (CC-BY-4.0) from Appendix B of "The Philosophical and Ethical Compass for
> Artificial Intelligence", with data contracts, drop-in prompts, a reference implementation
> and adoption instructions. The primitives are design rules with falsifiers, not a
> certification, and they never override an existing safety policy.

Read first: the ingest protocol in compass/compass.json (key "ingest_protocol").

## Data

- [compass/compass.json](compass/compass.json): the full compass: primitives, floor, questions, stack, classes, adoption procedure, ingest protocol, limits
- [compass/compass.schema.json](compass/compass.schema.json): schema for compass.json
- [compass/schemas/](compass/schemas/): nine data contracts for the records the primitives produce
- [compass/README.md](compass/README.md): field-by-field description

## Prompts

- [compass/prompts/compass-system-prompt.md](compass/prompts/compass-system-prompt.md): drop-in system prompt (the ten context-enforceable primitives)
- [compass/prompts/compass-agent-addendum.md](compass/prompts/compass-agent-addendum.md): addendum for tool-using agents
- [compass/prompts/README.md](compass/prompts/README.md): what a prompt can and cannot carry; five probes

## Code

- [projects/2026-10-22_compasskit/](projects/2026-10-22_compasskit/): reference implementation and CLI (standard-library Python)

## Docs

- [docs/IMPLEMENTING.md](docs/IMPLEMENTING.md): how to adopt the compass, layer by layer
- [docs/ARCHITECTURE.md](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): the architecture and its trust boundaries
- [docs/WHAT-AI-GAINS.md](docs/WHAT-AI-GAINS.md): failure modes, primitives, falsifiers
- [docs/PRIMITIVES.md](docs/PRIMITIVES.md): the full catalogue in Markdown (generated)
- [docs/RESEARCH.md](docs/RESEARCH.md): the book's argument, the convergent floor, the graded formal bridges
- [NOTICE.md](NOTICE.md): source, licence and changes
